source_metadata.title: Characteristics, management, and outcomes of segmental and subsegmental pulmonary embolism in ICU patients: A retrospective cohort study

extraction_limitations: Extraction was limited to the 16-page main article PDF supplied by the user; the separately referenced Supporting Information DOCX (S1 File) was not supplied and was not atomized.
Main-text statements that depend on supplementary tables or figures were represented only to the extent they were explicitly reported in the main article.
The Figure 2 major-bleeding adjusted odds ratio was not numerically reported in the main-text prose and was not estimated from the plotted graphic.
Review status is needs_review because the atoms were model-extracted and validated but not independently human-verified.
